title: Λ, the weighted geometric mean, as a validated contract
honesty: Λ is an advisory, non-compensatory roll-up. Λ uniqueness is Conjecture 1 (open); nothing in this contract depends on it.

algorithm.log_lambda: -inf if some x_k == 0, else math.fsum(w_k * math.log(x_k))
algorithm.why_fsum: fsum is correctly rounded, so Λ is bitwise invariant under a permutation of (axes, weights)

domain.axes: list or tuple of real numbers (bool is not a number); every x_k finite and 0 <= x_k <= 1
domain.weights: list or tuple of real numbers, the same length as axes; every w_k finite and w_k > 0; |fsum(weights) - 1| <= weight_sum_tol
domain.renormalisation: never: weights are used as declared
domain.clamping: never: a non-finite or out-of-range value is an error
domain.output: Λ in [0, 1]; exactly 0.0 iff some x_k == 0 (a veto, not an error)

error_codes.when: axes or weights is not a list/tuple (checked first), or an element is not a real number (checked after LAMBDA_LENGTH_MISMATCH)
len(axes) != len(weights); a dropped axis is never renormalised away
gate only: tau is not a real number, not finite, or outside (0, 1]; checked before Λ

precedence: Checks run in the order of error_codes, each over every element, so the reported code does not depend on axis order. The gate checks tau first.

tau.domain: real, finite, 0 < tau <= 1 (tau = 0 would pass a vetoed Λ = 0)

gate.compare: log space on the unrounded value: delta = log_lambda - log(tau)

canonical_float: f64:<16 lowercase hex digits of the IEEE-754 binary64 bits, big-endian>
legacy_not_canonical: tests/lambda_aggregator_source.py: +Inf counts as 1, NaN leaks, empty gives 0.0, weights are renormalised
torch-ext/szl_lambda_gate/_lambda.py lambda_aggregate: clamps, routes NaN/Inf to 0, renormalises; pinned in tests/test_lambda_v1_torch_divergence.py
